name: Smooth Trend
description: Smooth line trend with a KPI header (latest, MTD, QTD, YTD or your own calculation), growth/degrowth coloring and smart tooltips.

encodings.name: Date
encodings.tooltip: A date or period. Continuous MONTH(Date) works best; discrete periods like Q1 2025 also work. MTD/QTD/YTD need a real date.

encodings.name: Value
encodings.tooltip: The measure to trend, e.g. SUM(Sales).

encodings.name: Series
encodings.tooltip: Optional. A dimension that splits the trend into several lines (up to 8; the rest are grouped as Other).

encodings.name: KPI
encodings.tooltip: Optional. Your own calculation for the header number (e.g. MTD Sales). Add a second measure to compare against it (e.g. Last Month Sales). Its value at the latest date is used.
